files.content:
# Clamp — v1

Difficulty: easy. Category: boundary validation.

Fix `clamp` so values below the lower bound return the lower bound, values above
the upper bound return the upper bound, and values inside the bounds are unchanged.
Inputs are integers with lower <= upper. Run the supplied unittest suite.
The initial repository intentionally fails. No reference patch is included.

files.content:
# Normalize whitespace in a slug

Repair slug.py so slug(text) lowercases words and joins them with one hyphen.
Treat runs of whitespace (including tabs and newlines) as separators, and ignore
leading/trailing whitespace. Empty or all-whitespace input produces an empty string.
Preserve punctuation. Do not modify the tests or this task description.

def slug(text: str) -> str:
    return text.strip().lower().replace(" ", "-")
